thesis: The speakers argue that investors should prioritize process over outcome because outcomes are heavily influenced by luck, requiring larger sample sizes to verify skill. They further contend that true investment edges fall into four categories—behavioral, analytical, informational, and technical—and that possessing an edge is distinct from the ability to monetize it efficiently.
